keyword: concrete pump certificate not printed Xingtai

title.en: Do Not Ask the Catalogue for a Certificate It Does Not Name
title.zh: 不要向目录索取它没有点名的证书

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai does not print certificate names on the pump sheets used here. An inquiry can ask a question. It cannot turn a blank into a certificate.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台的这些泵页上不印证书名称。询盘可以提问。它不能把空白变成证书。

h1.en: Certificate Names Are Not on These Buying Sheets
h1.zh: 这些采购页上没有证书名称

directAnswer.en: The pump, mixer and spraying sheets published by Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai list power, output, pressure, distance and similar cells. They do not name a certificate, a test report number or a conformity mark. Do not add one to the purchase order. If you need the factory to say what documentation it can provide, ask that as a question on [/en/contact/](/en/contact/) after the model path is clear. This article will not invent the document.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台）公布的泵、搅拌泵和喷涂机页面列出动力、输送量、压力、距离等格子。它们不点名证书、检测报告编号或符合性标志。不要把这些写进采购订单。如果你需要工厂说明它能提供什么文件，请在型号路径清楚之后，在 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/) 作为问题提出。本篇不会编造文件。

body.en: A buying comparison uses the cells that exist. Electric 40’s 45 kW and 21 m³/h are printed. A certificate title next to them is not.
body.zh: 采购对照使用存在的格子。电动40的 45 kW 和 21 m³/h 是印出来的。旁边的证书标题不是。

heading.en: Sprayers are quote-only, still without a certificate line
heading.zh: 喷涂机只询价，仍然没有证书行

body.en: The spraying pages say quote only. That phrase is about price, not about a named approval. Particle size and motor remain the buying cells.
body.zh: 喷涂页写的是询价报价。这句话说的是价格，不是一份点名的许可。粒径和电机仍然是采购格。

body.en: Write: “Please tell us which documents Xingtai can provide for this path.” Do not write a standard number the site never printed.
body.zh: 请写：“请告知邢台能为这条路径提供哪些文件。”不要写网站从未印过的标准编号。

question.zh: 电动80上印了 CE 吗？

answer.en: No certificate mark is printed on that sheet in the catalogue used here.
answer.zh: 在此处使用的目录里，该页没有印证书标志。

answer.en: No. It means the price is not listed.
answer.zh: 不是。它表示价格没有列出。

question.en: Can the factory answer a document question?
question.zh: 工厂可以回答文件问题吗？

answer.en: Ask on the contact page. Do not pre-write the answer.
answer.zh: 在询盘页问。不要预先写下答案。

question.en: Should the order say “with certificate” as a default?
question.zh: 订单是否默认写“含证书”？

answer.en: No. That phrase is not a catalogue cell.
answer.zh: 不要。这句话不是目录格。
